title: Fourier coefficient of a point mass at the all-one vector
statement: Let $k$ be a nonnegative integer and let $S$ be any subset of the $k+1$ coordinates. The Fourier coefficient at $S$ of the function that equals $2$ at the all-one vector and $0$ elsewhere on the $(k+1)$-dimensional Boolean cube is $2^{-k}$.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a subset of the $k+1$ coordinates
